messages:
Priyanka V: hey folks, brand new here. quick question: i'm behind a corporate firewall and want to run a few streaming smoke tests. should i be using the sandbox key or a hosted key? and is there a simple way to make traffic come from a stable IP for security to whitelist? also i don't want to accidentally trigger 429s during my tests.

Leo (DevEx): welcome Priyanka! Use a sandbox key for local/dev testing. Hosted keys are for staging/prod. Sandbox keys have lower default quotas. Grab one in Console -> API Keys.

Leo (DevEx): for stable egress we offer an "org-forwarder" devproxy that egresses from a fixed IP you can give to security. If you need something quick, spin up a dev VM in the dev VPC and run tests from there.

InfraBot: Info: sandbox defaults = 50 req/min and 6 concurrent streaming sessions per key. Temporary test bumps accepted via infra ticket (include start/end time and expected rps).

Priyanka V: how do i use the devproxy locally vs the org-forwarder? any quick commands?

Ben - SRE: local devproxy (your machine egress):
```
docker run -e RW_API_KEY=sandbox_YYY -p 8080:8080 redwood/devproxy:local
# use http://localhost:8080 as the API endpoint
```
Org-forwarder (egress from stable IP 198.51.100.23) requires infra-issued client token. File an infra ticket to get access.

Priyanka V: thanks. what's the best way to avoid 429s if my harness ramps quickly?

Leo (DevEx): ramp gradually, respect Retry-After, and use exponential backoff + jitter. For streaming, prefer pacing by tokens/sec rather than opening many parallel connections. Also check X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset in responses.

Priyanka V: any tiny curl/snippet to detect limits?

Ben - SRE: quick header check:
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer sandbox_YYY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream | grep -E "Retry-After|X-RateLimit-"
```
If you see Retry-After, wait that many seconds. For CI, mint ephemeral tokens (one per runner) to spread load.

Priyanka V: perfect — i'll try local devproxy + small ramp. i'll open an infra ticket if we need org-forwarder or a temporary quota bump. thanks all! :pray:

Leo (DevEx): happy to help — ping me on the ticket and we can review your test script quickly.
